# Burgas 2027 Guide

> Independent, locally run fan travel guide for the Eurovision Song Contest 2027 in Burgas, Bulgaria (semi-finals 11 and 13 May, Grand Final 15 May 2027, Arena Burgas). Written by a team living in Burgas: accommodation, transport, flights, tickets, events and up-to-date local news. Not affiliated with the EBU or BNT.

Key facts (updated 17 November 2026): tickets go on sale in January 2027 via eurovision.com/tickets (free Eurofan account required); nine ticketed shows between 10 and 15 May 2027; 36 participating countries confirmed, Canada debuts; prices not yet announced.

## Latest news
- [Eurovision 2027 tickets: sales open in January](https://burgas2027guide.com/news/eurovision-2027-tickets-burgas-january/): sale timing, nine shows, Eurofan, what is still unknown
- [Fake Eurovision 2027 tickets warning](https://burgas2027guide.com/news/eurovision-2027-fake-tickets-warning-burgas/): Burgas Municipality and BNT warning, how to spot scams
